scope: Initial official evidence intake for the Rio Jequetepeque system. This package treats the basin, tributaries, regulated hydraulic system and lower-valley exposure as distinct evidence layers until reproducible geometry and event-specific routing are independently validated.

el_nino_context.source_basis: ANA basin context states strong El Nino episodes with intense rainfall can intensify erosion, debris-flow and fluvial-scour processes in the middle and lower Jequetepeque basin.
el_nino_context.interpretation: This is climate-regime context, not an event label or probability.

next_normalization_steps: obtain official Cuenca Jequetepeque geometry and separately identify river/tributary geometry
resolve the hydrologic relationship of Rio Chaman before any grouping
build dated local outcome ledger for 1982-83, 1997-98, 2017, 2023 and recent episodes
identify rainfall, river stage/discharge and reservoir-operation observations with timestamps and QA
map Pacasmayo/Chepen settlements, agriculture, roads, irrigation and hydraulic infrastructure exposure
separate current protection works and regulated-system operations from historical natural response
scientific_limits: No dated EVENT/NONE ledger is closed in this asset.
Current prevention works are not historical hydraulic capacity.
The 26 km and 15.15 km intervention lengths are not basin geometry or event footprints.
No reservoir operation or discharge value is transferred into an IRFEN threshold.
No negative control is inferred from absence of impact reporting.
